name: go9_se_globalpool
hypothesis: SE blocks (channel attention) + global pooling in value head + 6 res blocks gives better feature quality and spatial awareness. KataGo and Leela Zero both use SE blocks.
success_criteria: >60% vs random by iter 100, loss monotonically decreasing. Compare to scale500 at same iteration count.
notes: From scratch (different architecture than Fix D). 200 iters, 500 games/iter. ~20% more params than Fix D due to SE blocks + deeper net.
